QuestInfo.2: You have completed your assignment for the week. Talk to #p2230000# at #m241000220# again next week to receive a new weekly quest.

yes.1: Why don't you go to #b#m241000226##k and eliminate #b600 #o8630017##k monsters for me? Do take care of yourself while you're on the mission.\r\n#r(Caution! This quest will reset at midnight on Sunday.)#k
